def fetch_threads_by_filter(api_name, filter_kwargs):
    # api_name: function name in apis.gmail
    all_items = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        fn = getattr(apis.gmail, api_name)
        kwargs = dict(access_token=gmail_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        kwargs.update(filter_kwargs)
        page = fn(**kwargs)
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

]
